note: Verified pilot batch — not a comprehensive library. Every URL was fetched directly and confirmed real before inclusion; anything I could not fetch was dropped rather than trusted from a search snippet. skill_codes reference the still-unreviewed skill-ontology-proposal.json codes; update these if you rename/merge those during review. Nothing here is inserted into the resources table — an apply script comes after you approve.
schema_note: resources.kind is enum('book','video','worksheet','game'). An interactive learning APP (Khan Academy Kids) maps cleanly to none of these — filed as 'game' below, but consider adding 'app' to the enum. Also note resources.skill_codes is text[] of skill CODES, whereas plan_activities.resource_id is a uuid FK — Plan's prompt selects by resourceId, so codes are only used for candidate filtering.

dropped_during_verification.candidate: Numberblocks (official YouTube channel) — place value / two-digit numbers
dropped_during_verification.reason: WebFetch could not render YouTube's dynamic page, so I could not confirm the channel identity or content. Very likely genuine and well-regarded (BBC/NCETM-linked), but unverified by me. Worth adding manually after your own check.
bbc.co.uk is not fetchable from this environment. Almost certainly real and free, but I did not verify it myself, so it is not included.

resources.title: Oxford Owl — Free eBook Library (Oxford University Press)
resources.verification_note: Fetched directly. Genuine Oxford University Press resource; 130+ eBooks free to read, ages 3–11, browsable by age band and by Oxford Level 1–20 / phonics book band. FREE BUT REQUIRES REGISTRATION — a parent must create an account, which is friction worth surfacing in the activity instructions. Best on desktop/tablet, not optimised for phones.

resources.title: Khan Academy Kids — free early-learning app (ages 2–8)
resources.verification_note: Fetched directly. Page states plainly: 'Always free. No ads.' Built with Stanford Graduate School of Education. Covers counting and number sense, addition/subtraction, place value and base-ten, geometry and spatial reasoning. The only fully-free, no-registration-wall, no-upsell resource in this batch — strongest candidate of the four.

resources.title: K5 Learning — Grade 1 Capitalization Worksheets
resources.verification_note: Fetched directly — free worksheets on capital letters for names, sentence starts, and dates/days/months. Punctuation-specific worksheets live on a separate K5 page, not this one. Site upsells a $5.29 workbook.

resources.title: K5 Learning — Grade 1 Pictograph Worksheets
resources.verification_note: Fetched directly — 2 worksheets free (reading/interpreting pictographs), 3 behind a $24/yr membership. Bar-graph worksheets are on a separate K5 page, not verified here. Framed by K5 as 'a stepping stone to bar graphs', which fits the PYP Phase 1→2 progression (pictographs before bar graphs).

resources.title: K5 Learning — Grade 1 CVC/CVCe Word Worksheets
resources.verification_note: Fetched directly — worksheets #1/#2 (short-vowel CVC) and #5/#6 (long-vowel CVCe) free; #3/#4/#7/#8 require membership. Site upsells a $3.99 Phonics B workbook.
